answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 8700 Country: India Title: Aslaam U Alaikum Wa Rehmatullahi Wa Barakatahu Respected Ulemas My question is as follows 1.After Farz Nimaz (obligatory salah) which is followed by Sunnah Nimaz i.e;Zuhr,Magrib & Ishaa prayers, should one read Zikrs & Duas or should one after Farz Nimaz in above mentioned times(Zuhr,Magrib & Ishaa prayers) directly offer Sunnah Nimaz without reading anything? 2.Kindly write the background of the above mentioned questions answer? KHUDA HAFIZ Question: Aslaam U Alaikum Wa Rehmatullahi Wa Barakatahu Respected Ulemas My question is as follows 1.After Farz Nimaz (obligatory salah) which is followed by Sunnah Nimaz i.e;Zuhr,Magrib & Ishaa prayers, should one read Zikrs & Duas or should one after Farz Nimaz in above mentioned times(Zuhr,Magrib & Ishaa prayers) directly offer Sunnah Nimaz without reading anything? 2.Kindly write the background of the above mentioned questions answer? KHUDA HAFIZ Answer ID: 8700 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2306/1896=B/1429) Having performed salah one should do short dua and then perform sunnah salah , there should not be much gap. This is proved from the Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ) that he used to recite the dua ( اللھم أنت السلام ومنک السلام ) and then offer the sunnah . (Tirmizi) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
